newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mixed, market seen growing.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mixed, market seen growing.

text.p: Croatian stocks were mixed on Thursday and brokers predicted the market would grow steadily as the political situation stabilised
"A stable political situation and decline of interest rates is awakening interest for investment in shares," said chairman of the Brokers' Association Dubravko Zganec.
"That will have an impact on prices which will go up with an increased volume of shares on the market," he told Reuters.
* Of six active iisues two were up, two fell and two stayed unchanged.
* Most active food processor Podravka gained five kuna to 235 with 2,662 issues sold.
* Drugs firm Pliva which traded 169 shares, rose 50 kuna to 11,250.
* Zagrebacka Banka edged down 15 kuna to 670 selling 653 ordinary shares.
* Hotelier Laguna lost 10 kuna to 800 but only 10 shares changed hands.
* Another hotelier Jadranturist stayed flat at 160 kuna with 80 issues sold.
* Confectioner Kras was also unchanged at 275 kuna on volume of 20 shares.
* Volume down at 3,638, turnover slightly higher at 3.0 million kuna.
